column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/app/codeql.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in codeql.rs; the others
# move to src/app/codeql/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target codeql --check` after adding an item to codeql.rs.
# codeql.rs keeps the types and constants the App's fields and every part share.
